title: Nova Rock Survival Guide
description: Essential tips and information for Nova Rock 2026 at Pannonia Fields II.

items.title: Train from Vienna
items.content: Train from Vienna (Wien Hbf) to Nickelsdorf takes ~45 min. Direct regional services run during festival.

items.title: Shuttle Buses
items.content: Dedicated shuttle buses from Nickelsdorf station to festival grounds run continuously.

items.title: Driving
items.content: Nickelsdorf is directly off the A4 motorway. Follow festival signage for parking fields.

items.title: 100% Cashless
items.content: Nova Rock is 100% cashless — no cash or cards accepted inside the festival grounds.

items.title: Top Up Online
items.content: Top up your PlayPass wristband online before arrival to avoid queues at the gate.

items.title: Top-up Stations
items.content: Top-up stations available at festival entrance but expect queues especially Thursday.

items.title: Wind Warning
items.content: The Pannonia Fields site is flat and exposed — wind can be brutal. Bring tent pegs and a mallet.

items.title: Eco Green Camping
items.content: Eco-friendly zone with recycling stations and solar-powered lighting (new 2026).

items.title: Medical Centre
items.content: Festival medical centre is marked on the map. Free first aid available.
